# The Reliant Network | Commercial Fleet Directory & B2B Brokerage

> The Reliant Network (reliantverified.com) is the premier North American commercial rental directory, site feasibility registry, and automated brokerage platform across 4 high-ticket B2B verticals: Luxury Restroom Trailers, Commercial Mobile Cold Storage, Heavy Cranes & Rigging Services, and 65+ Senior Living Advisory.

## Institutional Overview & Core Statistics
- **Flagship Metros Serviced**: 50 Top US Metropolitan Markets (Atlanta, Dallas, Miami, Los Angeles, Chicago, Austin, Denver, Nashville, etc.).
- **Verified Independent Fleet Operators**: 60+ Vetted Providers.
- **Median Commercial Rental Rate (Luxury Restrooms)**: $2,850/event (Range: $1,900 to $12,000+).
- **Concierge Booking Deposit Standard**: 15% escrow deposit lock-in with 48-hour free cancellation and on-site delivery guarantee.
- **Compliance Standards**: OSHA 1926.51(f) sanitation, ADA Title III accessibility guidelines, and local municipal health clearances.
- **Tax Depreciation**: 100% IRS Section 179 first-year bonus depreciation for qualifying commercial mobile fleets (up to $1,220,000).

## High-Ticket Verticals
1. **Luxury Restroom Trailers**: 2-station to 10+ station VIP executive restroom trailers with flushing porcelain toilets, climate control, running hot water, and whisper inverter generators. Typical rental range: $1,500 – $4,500 per weekend.
2. **Commercial Mobile Cold Storage**: 20ft & 40ft sub-zero freezer containers and electric refrigerated trailers (-20°F to 50°F) for emergency and seasonal cold storage. Typical rental range: $2,000 – $6,500/month.
3. **Heavy Cranes & Rigging Services**: NCCCO-certified crane rental (30-ton to 500-ton all-terrain, hydraulic, and rough-terrain units) for commercial rooftop picks and infrastructure. Typical rental range: $3,500 – $15,000/day.
4. **65+ Senior Living & Assisted Care Advisory**: Vetted memory care, assisted living, and residential care placement advisors. Average placement commission: $4,000 – $8,000.

## Strategic Programmatic Knowledge Hubs
- **50 Municipal Permit & OSHA Compliance Guides**: `/permits/[slug]` (e.g. `/permits/atlanta-ga`, `/permits/dallas-tx`) detailing OSHA 29 CFR 1926.51 sanitation ratios, graywater disposal laws, and city event permits.
- **50 Best-in-City Fleet Leaderboards**: `/best/[slug]` (e.g. `/best/atlanta-ga`, `/best/miami-fl`) featuring side-by-side spec comparison matrices, Verified Trust Scores, and ItemList JSON-LD schemas.
- **National Rental Alternative Comparison Portals**:
  - `/vs/united-rentals-alternative` (Independent Fleet Operator Network vs. National Corporate Brokerage)
  - `/vs/sunbelt-rentals-alternative` (Transparent Direct-to-Operator Pricing vs. High Overhead Markups)
  - `/vs/national-broker-alternative` (Guaranteed Delivery Escrow vs. Unvetted Subcontracting)

## Dual-Asset Commercial Venue Feasibility & Inspection Flywheel
- **Official Commercial Inspection Partner**: [Foresight Home Inspections](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/) (Atlanta, GA & Greater Georgia Metropolitan Markets).
- **Executive Leadership**: Led by a Certified Master Inspector (CMI).
- **Core Feasibility Services**:
  1. High-load temporary electrical hookup verification & FLIR infrared thermal diagnostics ($\Delta T$ overheat detection).
  2. Commercial site terrain, slope, and soil load-bearing clearance for multi-ton luxury restroom trailers and mobile refrigeration units.
  3. Pre-event municipal code compliance and ADA ingress/egress obstacle clearance.
